G2 (2.048 m). Octagon facade, NW face (study), from the NNE corner to the north jamb of terrace door D15 (1B24B3).

G3 (2.638 m). Octagon facade, NW face, from D15's south jamb (1B24B2) to the north solid pier (wall-layer hatch 1BB410, 0.25 m deep). The study / living movable partition D16 meets it at (187.335,-3487.868).
G4 (6.210 m). Octagon facade, west face (living / dining), between the two solid piers 1BB410 and 1BB411; glass at x 185.598-185.778.

G5 (5.784 m). Octagon facade, SW face, from the south pier (1BB411) to the SSW corner. The 80 mm living / bedroom wall (1B8DBD) meets its room face at (187.396,-3502.521): living room to the north of that point, bedroom to the south.
G6 (1.875 m). Octagon facade, SSW face (bedroom), running down to the south facade line y = -3506.518.

G7 (10.157 m). South glazing (bedroom, then jacuzzi), NOT drawn. Placed between the room-outline line y -3506.518 (Defpoints 1BBFC4, railing base line) and the beam edge y -3506.556 (KT_BIEN DAM RED 1B1C68); the balustrade (KT-Lancan) is 0.15 m outside. The bath glass panel and its 0.18 m base stub (1B22FF) meet it at x 197.69-197.87. It ends at the added party wall, whose room-side line reaches the facade at x 201.019.

G8 (10.783 m). North glazing (study, then gym), NOT drawn. Placed between the room-outline line y -3483.793 (Defpoints 1B50FA / 1B50FF, railing base line) and the beam edge y -3483.756. The 80 mm study / gym wall (x 197.325-197.405) meets it. It ends at the drawn gym NE wall (hatch 1B05B6). The balustrade outside it stops at x 200.94.

G9 (0.510 m). Corner link from the north end of the octagon band to the north glazing: NOT drawn (a 0.5 m gap). Inferred the same way as the 19 Oct build's slanted piece (191.52,-3483.38 to 191.73,-3483.775). Low confidence.

G10 (1.165 m). Fixed interior glass panel between the bedroom (the strip south of the walk-in closet) and the jacuzzi: three thin lines at x 197.69 / 197.72 / 197.75 on A-1.Netthay (1B22F1 / F0 / F2), running from the end of the bath's west wall (y -3505.318) to the panel's base stub at the facade (1B22FF). Assumed full height (the build uses 0-3.0 m); no sill is drawn, so it is not a window.

uncertain.what: The bath / jacuzzi divider is drawn only as kerb lines, with steps at x 198.70-200.64 on layer 0. If it is really a half-height or full wall, the step gap is an opening. It is not keyed.

D14 sits in the added party wall, so its a/b come from the 1.00 m leaf. The drawn corner piece 1B2234 ends 0.073 m beyond the leaf tip, so the structural opening may be 1.07-1.10 m. The 0.25 m wall thickness is the build's assumption.

D16: the key uses the structural span from the glass face to the wall end (5.93 m). The clear width between the stacked panels is 4.86 m (the hand list's value). A wall-layer tick (1B226B) 0.30 m from the glass could mark an end post.

O1 centre line is ambiguous: the pier's end face is vertical (0.24 m) and the powder-room wall is 0.30 m, so the two ends are not on one centre line. The key uses the midpoints of the two end faces, good to about +-0.08 m.
O4 is a passage mouth: one wall end facing a perpendicular wall face. Optional for scoring.
X1 (added) is a passage mouth into the kitchen, the same case as O4, marked by a dashed overhead line. Optional for scoring.
The corner between the octagon glass (ending at 191.52,-3483.38) and the north glazing (starting at 191.68,-3483.79) is not drawn. G9 is inferred, as in the build.

The north glazing is not drawn; it is placed between the room-outline line y -3483.793 and the beam edge y -3483.756. No door onto the Juliet balcony is drawn (the balustrade is 0.15 m outside the glass).
The south glazing is not drawn; it is placed between y -3506.518 and the beam edge y -3506.556. No door is drawn.
A void behind the toilet (x 201.65-202.65, y -3503.12 / -3504.47) opens only toward the added party wall, probably a riser. If there is an access door from the corridor, it is not drawn.
D8 is drawn with dashed (HIDDEN2) lines, possibly a concealed door. The wall gap is real.
D1's jambs are on A-4. Dim, not the wall layer. A detector that reads only wall layers will see the foyer's east side as a 2.17 m open end (y -3494.031 to -3496.201).
